spec2def(libxslt.dll libxslt.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/libxslt/include/libxslt
                    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/libxslt/include
                    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/libwin-iconv)

add_definitions(
    -DHAVE_CONFIG_H
    -DWIN32
    -D_WINDOWS
    -D_MBCS
    -DHAVE_WIN32_THREADS
    -D_REENTRANT
    -DLIBXML_STATIC
    # This tree supplies its own CRT, so security.c's HAVE__STAT->stat()->_stat()
    # remap (see win32config.h, meant for a stock MSVC CRT) must not fire.
    # Pre-defining HAVE_STAT here makes security.c's `#ifndef HAVE_STAT` guard
    # skip that remap unconditionally, regardless of win32config.h's HAVE__STAT.
    -DHAVE_STAT)

# libxslt.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/libxslt-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(libxslt_shims OBJECT attributes.c attrvt.c documents.c extensions.c extra.c functions.c imports.c keys.c namespaces.c numbers.c pattern.c preproc.c security.c templates.c transform.c variables.c xslt.c xsltlocale.c xsltutils.c)
target_link_libraries(libxslt_shims PRIVATE libxml2 iconv-static zlib libmsvcrt libws2_32 libbcrypt libkernel32 libntdll)
if(MSVC)
    if(ARCH STREQUAL "amd64" OR ARCH STREQUAL "arm64")
        target_compile_options(libxslt_shims PRIVATE /wd4267)
    endif()
endif()
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(libxslt_shims PRIVATE -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-pointer-sign -Wno-unused-function)
endif()
add_cargo_module(libxslt libxslt-cargo libxslt.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS libxslt_shims psdk)
